name: Search Files
description: Search file contents or find files by name under the workplace root.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Prefer this over shell grep/find. Uses ripgrep (rg) when available, then grep/find, then a pure-Python fallback. target=content (default): regex search inside files (Hermes-aligned; pass regex=false for literal/fixed-string). target=files: find by filename/glob (e.g. '*.py' or 'config'). output_mode: content | files_only | count. Optional path, glob, context, limit, offset.

pattern.description: For content: regex pattern (default) or literal if regex=false. For files: glob or name substring.

target.description: content = search inside files; files = find by name/glob.

glob.description: Optional filename glob filter for content search (e.g. *.py).

regex.description: Treat content pattern as regex (default true, like Hermes). Set false for fixed-string / literal match (rg -F). For target=files, default is glob; set true to regex-match filenames.

output_mode.description: content = path:line:snippet; files_only = paths; count = per-file counts.

context.description: Context lines around each content match (0–5).

offset.description: Skip first N results for pagination.
